dimensions.assessment: Directly affects federal agency personnel conducting the study and indirectly concerns nursing workforce grant recipients and nursing staff.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Health and Human Services and the Secretary of Labor, jointly, shall conduct a review

dimensions.assessment: Mandates an administrative review and reporting process without altering funding or program rules directly.
dimensions.evidence: submit to Congress a report on the review... that includes recommendations for changes

dimensions.assessment: No appropriations or changes to federal spending levels are authorized.
Requires an interagency study and report focusing on nurse faculty, experienced nurse pathways, and LPN-to-RN pipelines.
dimensions.evidence: conduct a study and issue a report on grant programs to support the nursing workforce

dimensions.assessment: Temporary one-time reporting requirement due not later than 1 year after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, submit to Congress a report

importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires HHS and the Department of Labor to conduct a joint review and submit a report to Congress on nursing workforce grant programs with specific recommendations.
